title: Run autograder test cases and write Gradescope-compatible JSON — run_autograder

title: Validate a recorded object — validate
text: records robjgrader_records object get_records(). name Character. Variable name recorded object. Primary identification method. match Named list coarse matching criteria used name   absent unknown (e.g. student chose different variable name,   object never assigned).  Must include type; keys   optional.  Criteria applied order discriminating power (  least) one candidate remains; criterion eliminate   remaining candidates skipped. Universal (types): type Required. One "ggplot", "model",       "df", "table". expr_contains Character. Fixed substring matched       source expression text (e.g. "filter(year == 2007)"). ggplot: aes_x, aes_y, aes_color, aes_colour,       aes_fill, aes_size, aes_shape, aes_alpha,       aes_group, aes_linetype Character. Expected variable       name mapped aesthetic. geom Character. Geom class name, either short       ("point") full ("GeomPoint"). Matches layer       uses geom. facet_var Character vector. Variable name(s) must       appear facet specification. model: outcome Character. Name response variable (LHS). estimator Character. Class model must inherit ,       e.g. "lm", "glm", "fixest". predictors Character vector. RHS variable names must       present model formula. fixed_effects Character vector. Fixed-effect variable       names (relevant fixest models). cluster Character vector. Clustering variable names. nobs Integer. Exact number observations. df: names Character vector. Column names must       present. nrow Integer. Exact number rows. ncol Integer. Exact number columns. table: expr_contains expr_contains effective       tables; structural criteria yet supported. reference Optional reference object.  Serves two roles: (1) neither name match given, reference used locate best-matching candidate automatically extracting structural criteria (type, aesthetics, model outcome, column names, etc.) running normal match logic; (2) candidate identified, reference used group-level semantic comparison. checks Named list type-specific property checks, character vector group names check reference. exclude Character vector group names skip reference provided. Individual checks unaffected. position Positional fallback matching yields > 1 candidate: "last" (default), "first", integer index among filtered candidates.
